name: replant_sx_targets
comment: Two-species replant (spruce + Douglas-fir) with spruce replant-area composition targets on a three-phase schedule (3 free + 5 ramp periods; tolerance band 0.10 once binding). The unconstrained baseline runs with the same replant actions, isolating the constraint's effect.

provenance.basis: public-safe example: replant composition targets with three-phase schedule
